name: Breath of Ecstasy
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: cleric 3, rook 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: one living creature
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Fort negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target of this spell feels a gentle breath across his face, inducing a state of intense, though brief, pleasure.

The target gains the dazed condition for 1 round.

In the following rounds, the target takes a -2 penalty on attacks, saving throws, skill and ability checks.

A spellcaster targeted by this spell must make a successful concentration check to cast spells while under its effect.
